summary:
Iter 49 — RETEST of iter_48 English-only finding. MASSIVE IMPROVEMENT: 7/9 primary screens are now fully English (home, /token, /recovery-suite, /pantry, /compass, /monolith, /dignity). Backend suite = 11 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed. Founder dev-bypass + /api/auth/me + core smoke (/api/, /api/origin, /api/lifecard, /api/token/wallet) all healthy. /api/token/wallet payload and /api/compass/offline-pack payload contain 0 Slovak diacritics and correctly expose 'Ambulance SK' + 'Sentinel Tier — 30 days (GA-T)'. Source scans of routes/token.py, routes/compass.py, routes/demo.py all clean.

REMAINING FINDINGS (both are backend-sourced strings that leak into the two of the requested screens):
  • /protocol — 3 Slovak marketplace item titles still shown: 'Anonymné dáta o liekoch na dýchacie cesty' (offer_id resp-eu-2026), 'Anonymná preočkovanosť V4 regiónu' (sk-vaccination), plus institution name 'Stredoeurópsky epidemiologický inštitút'. Source: /app/backend/routes/gateway.py:103,105 (offers list served to /protocol). E1's iter-49 backend sweep translated token.py/compass.py/demo.py but MISSED gateway.py.
  • /wealth-vault — long consent paragraph 'Seeds/kľúče sú zapečatené zero-knowledge (plaintext sa nikdy neukladá). Manifest hash je ukotvený na Mosaic Chain — Proof of Asset Stewardship.' Source: /app/backend/routes/wealth.py:179 (policy field). E1's iter-49 backend sweep also MISSED wealth.py.

Other backend routes still with Slovak content that may surface elsewhere (not blocking for this iter's checklist but E1 should be aware): medic.py (60 hits — protocols demo), hunter.py (35 hits), pantry.py (25 hits — pantry backend strings, though frontend /pantry itself is clean), plus 25+ additional route files with residual Slovak.

Home screen renders cleanly with home-orb FAB (Guardian Eye), tab bar (HEALING/FAMILY SHIELD/VAULT), and DEMO badge visible. 0 console errors during navigation across 9 screens. No red-screen or crash on any tested screen.

minor.issue: Marketplace offers list at routes/gateway.py:103,105 still contains Slovak titles: 'Anonymné dáta o liekoch na dýchacie cesty', 'Anonymná preočkovanosť V4 regiónu' and institution 'Stredoeurópsky epidemiologický inštitút'. Needs English translation (e.g. 'Anonymous respiratory medication data', 'Anonymous V4 regional revaccination', 'Central European Epidemiology Institute').

Consent paragraph is Slovak: 'Seeds/kľúče sú zapečatené zero-knowledge (plaintext sa nikdy neukladá). Manifest hash je ukotvený na Mosaic Chain — Proof of Asset Stewardship.' Suggest EN: 'Seeds/keys are sealed zero-knowledge (plaintext is never stored). Manifest hash is anchored on Mosaic Chain — Proof of Asset Stewardship.'

All Slovak text visible on those two screens now originates from backend responses, not from the *.tsx files (frontend source is clean).

issues: 3 marketplace offer titles + 1 institution name in Slovak (backend routes/gateway.py:100-107).

Backend translation is partial — completing routes/gateway.py + routes/wealth.py will close the remaining two /protocol + /wealth-vault gaps.

rca_of_issue: iter_48 flagged both frontend AND backend leaks. iter_49 successfully closed all frontend .tsx leaks in the 8 requested screens AND closed backend leaks in token.py/compass.py/demo.py. However 2 screens still leak because their Slovak text originates from OTHER backend routes that were not part of this iter's sweep: gateway.py (marketplace offers rendered on /protocol) and wealth.py (consent policy rendered on /wealth-vault). Reproduction: with founder session, navigate to /protocol → observe Slovak marketplace offer titles; navigate to /wealth-vault → observe Slovak consent paragraph beneath the anchor-to-chain CTAs. Fix: replicate the same literal-string English replacements in gateway.py:100-110 and wealth.py:179. After patching, restart backend (`sudo supervisorctl restart backend`) and re-run the frontend diacritic scan to confirm 0 hits.
